summary: Adds a user search endpoint. One SQL injection and one style issue remain open.

findings.title: User input is interpolated into a SQL string
findings.rationale: The q parameter reaches cursor.execute through an f-string, so any caller can run arbitrary SQL.
findings.evidence: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '{q}'")  # q from request.args

findings.title: Mutable default argument
findings.rationale: The list default is shared across calls, so items leak between invocations.

references.title: Google Python Style Guide 2.12 Default Argument Values

findings.title: Log message could name the query
findings.rationale: Including the query id would make the log line traceable.
